text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...It's so hot... Like power is welling 
up from deep within my body..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Could this perhaps... be your doing?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I will gratefully make use of this.
